items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: So now there’s a couple of guys, friends of mine now, they’re let me see, Dean Pratt and Don Sickler.

ctx.x: Oh that’s what it was. So everything was mostly head arrangements, that’s how they started those heads. But the thing was, what was bad about it was the promoters, who knew nothing about music, but they just happened to know the musicians, they would get them in the studio and they would say “just make something up.” And they would make something up and then somebody would come up with a name for the song, and the guys
would never get any royalties for it. So now there’s a couple of guys, friends of mine now, they’re let me see, Dean Pratt and Don Sickler. Do you know those names?
